results.rationale: Consistency: The white background and brown/yellow palette remain, but both books move downward and their top-cover geometry changes, including an extended left corner on the thin book. Instruction: The right book remains thin with a narrow page block; the expected result is a right page block matching the thick left book. No meaningful thickness adjustment is visible. Quality: Structure, lighting and page textures are coherent; the thin book has a small awkward protruding upper-left cover flap.

Instruction: The already-thick left book is enlarged while the right book stays thin; the required right-book thickness match is absent. Quality: The books have coherent covers, pages and lighting; a small dark blurred wedge at the gap between them disrupts otherwise clean contours.
